Golden fixtures for `swiftshot verify`, shared by the Swift and the JVM implementation. Each case
directory holds the inputs (`baseline/` with `baseline.json`, `output/` with
`swiftshot-report.json`, `config.json` with the comparison settings) and the expected report files
(`expected/result.json`, `expected/junit.xml`, `expected/manifest.json`, and `expected/images/`,
generated by the engine). Run verify with `SWIFTSHOT_COMMIT=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`,
`SWIFTSHOT_BRANCH=feature/x`, `SWIFTSHOT_VERSION_OVERRIDE=1.0.0-test` and `SWIFTSHOT_CI=false`; every output must match
byte for byte, and the exit code must follow `status` (passed 0, failed 1, error 2). The format is
[docs/wiki/Baseline-format.md](../../../docs/wiki/Baseline-format.md); `python3 -I make.py`
regenerates everything except `expected/images/`, which the JVM engine writes
(`SWIFTSHOT_WRITE_FIXTURE_IMAGES=1` on `CompareTest`) and `make.py` checks pixel and byte for byte.
